full_judgment: "In the change of attitude on the part of the defence and in its failure to produce documents-presumably available and probably decisive one way or another if examined, the learned Judges saw a design on the part of the defendant to take advantage of the abstract doctrine of the burden of proof upon a plaintiff in ejectment".
